entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 164800235906366976: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2474 +/- 0.0270 mas (same row, RUWE 1.36): 160.07 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 12.104, -18.145 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.45 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of IRAS 04125+2902 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024Natur.635..574B/abstract). Mass 0.7 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of IRAS 04125+2902 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024Natur.635..574B/abstract). Temperature 4080 +/- 95 K from Barber et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of IRAS 04125+2902 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,080 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd5a9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,080 K and log g 3.96 (u1 0.839, u2 -0.033): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
